title.en: Publish narrated first-time video tours for visitors and members
title.zh: 发布面向访客与会员的双语语音新手视频教程

purpose.en: Help a first-time visitor understand SmartLingo before joining and help a new member find saved learning, scores, courses, community, messages, and account security without exposing private account data.
purpose.zh: 帮助第一次访问者在注册前理解 SmartLingo，并帮助新会员找到已保存学习、成绩、课程、社区、消息与账户安全功能，同时不暴露任何私人账户资料。

en: Add separate Chinese and English first-time tour videos with natural text-to-speech narration, burned-in key captions, and selectable WebVTT captions.
Cover the signed-out visitor journey first and the signed-in member journey second, including email-code and password sign-up choices.
Add an easy-to-find tutorial action near the top of the home page and a dedicated public tutorial player page.
Localize the tutorial page and home action across all twelve interface languages while routing Chinese to the Chinese recording and every other locale to English.
zh: 新增独立的中文与英文新手导览视频，包含自然文字转语音旁白、画面重点字幕及可选择的 WebVTT 字幕。
先完整介绍未登录访客流程，再介绍登录会员流程，并覆盖邮箱验证码与密码两种注册选择。
在首页顶部附近增加易发现的教程入口，并新增公开教程播放器页面。
为全部十二种界面语言本地化教程页与首页入口；中文使用中文视频，其他语言统一使用英文视频。

en: SmartLingo public home hero, new language-prefixed tutorial route, static tutorial media, captions, and responsive layout release matrix.
Learning data, member progress, Clerk configuration, D1, college records, course commerce, AI providers, and external-service boundaries remain unchanged.
zh: 涉及 SmartLingo 公开首页首屏、新增的语言前缀教程路由、静态教程媒体、字幕与响应式布局发布矩阵。
学习数据、会员进度、Clerk 配置、D1、学院记录、课程交易、AI 提供方及外部服务边界保持不变。

en: Produce a 25-chapter Chinese tour lasting 11:19 and a 25-chapter English tour lasting 10:21 in Safari-compatible H.264 Main Profile with AAC narration and fast-start metadata.
Mask the dedicated QA member identity and account email, remove browser chrome from member captures, and never record a real password or verification code.
Render a responsive HTML5 video player with controls, inline mobile playback, poster artwork, metadata-only preload, and no autoplay.
Expand the release WebKit matrix from 260 to 270 cases so the new route is checked in Chinese and English at five required viewports.
zh: 制作 25 章、时长 11:19 的中文教程，以及 25 章、时长 10:21 的英文教程；采用 Safari 兼容的 H.264 Main Profile、AAC 旁白与 fast-start 元数据。
遮挡专用 QA 会员身份和账户邮箱，清理会员截图中的浏览器栏，并且绝不录制真实密码或验证码。
使用响应式 HTML5 播放器，提供控件、移动端行内播放、封面图、仅元数据预载且不自动播放。
将发布 WebKit 矩阵由 260 项扩充至 270 项，让新路由在中英文与五种必测视口下持续验收。

en: Require TypeScript no-emit, zero-warning ESLint, verified vinext production builds, sensitive-data scans, tutorial media contract tests, and the repository test suite.

Decode both finished MP4 files end to end, verify H.264 plus AAC streams, measure audible narration at -18.4 dB Chinese and -16.2 dB English average volume, and inspect visitor, member, and masked-account frames.
Run the real WebKit tutorial matrix across Chinese and English at 390x844, 430x932, 834x1112, 1194x834, and 1440x1000 with all 10 combinations passing.
zh: 要求 TypeScript no-emit、零告警 ESLint、已验证 vinext 生产构建、敏感数据扫描、教程媒体契约测试与全仓测试通过。
对两支最终 MP4 做全片解码，验证 H.264 与 AAC 音轨，实测中文平均响度 -18.4 dB、英文 -16.2 dB，并人工检查访客、会员及邮箱遮挡画面。
使用真实 WebKit 在 390x844、430x932、834x1112、1194x834、1440x1000 下完成中英文教程矩阵，10 个组合全部通过。

en: The current release provides full Chinese and English narration; the other ten interface languages intentionally use the English recording while retaining localized page controls and explanatory copy.
Videos are intentionally user-started and do not request microphone access; speaking-practice permissions remain separate and opt-in.
zh: 本次提供完整中文与英文旁白；其余十种界面语言按要求使用英文视频，同时保留本地化页面控件与说明文案。
视频必须由用户主动播放且不会请求麦克风；口语练习权限继续独立并由用户主动开启。

en: Use SmartLingo's existing green, cream, and coral visual language, shared header and footer, and visitor/member terminology without copying a competitor's branded assets.
Preserve the isolated SmartLingo repository, existing user-owned dirty files, Clerk and Cloudflare boundaries, and GitHub Actions-to-Cloudflare deployment path.
zh: 沿用 SmartLingo 既有绿色、米色与珊瑚色视觉语言、共用页眉页脚及访客／会员术语，不复制竞争对手品牌资产。
保留 SmartLingo 独立代码库、用户已有未提交文件、Clerk 与 Cloudflare 边界，以及 GitHub Actions 至 Cloudflare 发布路径。
